import os,sys,json,time,subprocess,pathlib
run=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
source=run/'control'
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GPFORUM_') and k not in {'PGHOST','PGPORT','PGUSER','PGPASSWORD','PGDATABASE','PGSERVICE','MOJO_MODE','MOJO_REACTOR','LIBEV_FLAGS','NYTPROF','PERL5OPT','PERL5LIB'}}
env['PATH']='/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@18/bin:'+env['PATH']
env['TMPDIR']='/private/tmp'
def peers():
 rows=[]
 for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,ppid=,command='],text=True).splitlines():
  p=line.strip().split(None,2)
  if len(p)==3: rows.append((int(p[0]),int(p[1]),p[2]))
 ours={os.getpid()}
 for _ in range(20): ours.update(pid for pid,parent,_ in rows if parent in ours)
 return [{'pid':pid,'command':cmd[:350]} for pid,parent,cmd in rows if pid not in ours and any(s in cmd for s in ['bin/prove ',' -S prove ','/perl t/integration/','node --test ','/script/perlcritic ','/script/test','script/fresh-checkout-check','script/benchmark-http-complete','script/performance-http','script/bench-socket','script/bench-render','cpanm ','cpm install']) and not cmd.startswith(('/bin/zsh -c','/bin/zsh -lc','/bin/sh -c'))]
history=[]
for _ in range(240):
 competing=peers()
 if not competing: break
 history.append({'time':time.time(),'phase':'waiting','peers':competing})
 (run/'monitor.json').write_text(json.dumps(history,indent=2))
 time.sleep(2)
else: sys.exit('competing verification remains active')
command=['script/gpforum-carton','exec','script/benchmark-http-complete','--output',str(run/'result'),'--workers','8','--worker-clients','16','--concurrency','100','--iterations','100','--warmup','10','--duration','6','--repetitions','3','--deadline','900','--scenario','member.thread']
record={'command':command,'source':str(source),'started':time.time(),'tmpdir':env['TMPDIR'],'harness_overlay':'diagnostic only: per-worker CPU phase timers, query/gate counters, pg_stat_statements, wait sampler'}
(run/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
observer=None
observer_log=(run/'observer.log').open('w')
with (run/'run.log').open('w') as log:
 child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=source,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record['child_pid']=child.pid
 (run/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
 while child.poll() is None:
  if observer is None and (run/'result/observer-dsn.json').exists():
   observer=subprocess.Popen(['script/gpforum-carton','exec','perl',str(run/'wait-sampler.pl'),str(run)],cwd=source,env=env,stdout=observer_log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  history.append({'time':time.time(),'phase':'running','peers':peers()})
  time.sleep(.5)
 code=child.returncode
(run/'result/observer-stop').touch()
if observer is not None:
 try: observer.wait(timeout=10)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: observer.terminate();observer.wait(timeout=5)
observer_log.close()
record.update({'exit':code,'finished':time.time(),'contaminated':any(x['peers'] for x in history if x['phase']=='running')})
(run/'monitor.json').write_text(json.dumps(history,indent=2))
(run/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
sys.exit(code)

from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,time,socket,json,shutil
run=Path(__file__).parent;source=run/'read-candidate';clam=run/'clamav';clam.mkdir();(clam/'db').mkdir()
shutil.copyfile('/private/tmp/gpforum-clamd-local-m6fqd93k/db/eicar.ndb',clam/'db/eicar.ndb')
config='\n'.join([f'DatabaseDirectory {clam}/db',f'LocalSocket {clam}/clamd.sock',f'TemporaryDirectory {clam}',f'PidFile {clam}/clamd.pid',f'LogFile {clam}/clamd.log','Foreground yes','StreamMaxLength 251M','MaxFileSize 251M','MaxScanSize 300M','AlertExceedsMax yes',''])
(clam/'clamd.conf').write_text(config)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GPFORUM_') and k not in {'PGHOST','PGPORT','PGUSER','PGPASSWORD','PGDATABASE','PGSERVICE','PERL5OPT','PERL5LIB','NYTPROF','MOJO_MODE'}}
env['PATH']='/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@18/bin:'+env['PATH'];env['TMPDIR']='/private/tmp';env['GPFORUM_CLAMD_SOCKET']=str(clam/'clamd.sock')
with (clam/'launch.log').open('w') as cl:
 proc=subprocess.Popen(['/opt/homebrew/sbin/clamd','--config-file='+str(clam/'clamd.conf')],stdout=cl,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 try:
  for _ in range(100):
   if proc.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('clamd exited')
   if (clam/'clamd.sock').exists():
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM) as client:
     client.settimeout(1);client.connect(str(clam/'clamd.sock'));client.sendall(b'zPING\0');reply=client.recv(100)
    if b'PONG' in reply:break
   time.sleep(.1)
  else:raise RuntimeError('clamd readiness timeout')
  (run/'owned-clamd.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':proc.pid,'config':str(clam/'clamd.conf'),'status':'running'}))
  with (run/'features-launch.log').open('w') as log:
   result=subprocess.run(['script/gpforum-carton','exec','perl','-Ilib',str(run/'run-features.pl'),str(run)],cwd=source,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  (run/'features-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit':result.returncode,'jobs':2,'postgres_connections':100,'real_clamav':True},indent=2))
  print('EXIT',result.returncode)
  print('\n'.join((run/'features-launch.log').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[-8:]),flush=True)
 finally:
  if proc.poll() is None:
   proc.terminate()
   try:proc.wait(timeout=10)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
  (run/'owned-clamd.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':proc.pid,'config':str(clam/'clamd.conf'),'status':'stopped'}))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
